title: The Quiet Group Chat
author: Oscar Thackeray
blurb: Orsen Villalobos, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
